label: Stocks and Shares ISA
Adult UK Stocks and Shares ISA. Income and capital gains are tax-free. The £20,000 annual contribution limit is shared with other ISAs; enter external ISA contributions. One modelled ISA per owner. This is a non-flexible ISA: withdrawals do not restore the year’s contribution room. Pension, Junior and Lifetime ISA rules are excluded.
